description: Variation of condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/0027/24 dated 16/10/2024 to allow overall reduction of gross internal floor area; balcony to rear elevation; external alterations
decision_conditions:
No demolition or site works in connection with the development hereby permitted shall commence before:-
(a) the frontage.
(b) the boundary.
of the site is enclosed by a close boarded fence to a minimum height of 2 metres.  Such fencing shall remain until works and clearance have been completed, and the development is ready for occupation.
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before three years from the date of planning permission PL/0027/24 dated 16/10/2024.

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until there has been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority, a scheme of hard and soft landscape works which shall include a survey of all existing trees and hedgerows on the land, indicating those to be retained and those to be lost.  Details of those to be retained, together with measures for their protection in the course of the development, shall also be submitted and approved, and carried out in accordance with such approval, prior to any demolition or any other site works, and retained until the development is completed.  Soft landscape works shall include: planting plans, and schedule of plants, noting species, plant sizes and proposed numbers/densities.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

The development hereby permitted shall not commence until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces noted below have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority:
(a) the extension/building(s)
(b) the ground surfacing
(c) the boundary treatment
The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: 2107 EX00A; 2107 EX01A; 2107 EX02A; 2107 EX03B; 594-PL 102E; 594-PL 200G; 594-PL 201B; 594-PL 300E; 594-PL 301D;  594-PL 400D; Design And Access Statement; Fire Statement; Cover Statement – Application for variation of Condition No.2.

<p class="MsoNormal">No development shall take place, including any works of
demolition, until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and
approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The Method Statement
shall provide for:<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(a) detailed timeline for the phases and implementation of
the development;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(b) demolition method statement;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(c) the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(d) loading and unloading of plant and materials;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(e) storage of plant and materials used in constructing the
development;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(f) measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during
construction; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(g) scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from
demolition and construction works.<o:p></o:p></p><p>















</p><p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be carried out in accordance with the
approved Method Statement &amp; Logistics Plan, or any amendment or variation
to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout
the construction period. This is a PRE-COMMENCEMENT Condition.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to commencement of ground development (with the except
of demolition or site survey work), full details of the means of foul surface
water disposal shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning
Authority. Connection to the Public Sewer should be the first considered method
of sewage disposal, however if the intention is not to connect to mains
drainage the submitted details must demonstrate why this is not practicable and
provide full details of the size, location and maintenance regimes of any
treatment system.&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal">The construction of the dwellinghouse hereby granted, shall
not commence until works for the disposal of surface water, and surface water
attenuation/storage have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the
local planning authority. The development shall be carried out in accordance
with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.<o:p></o:p></p>

Before the hard surfacing hereby permitted is brought into use the surfacing shall EITHER be constructed from porous materials, for example, gravel, permeable block paving or porous asphalt, OR provision shall be made to direct run-off water from the hard surfacing to a permeable or porous area or surface within the curtilage of the site.
Please note: guidance on permeable paving has now been published by the Environment Agency on http://www.communities.gov.uk/publications/planningandbuilding/pavingfrontgardens.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015  (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, B and D in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.&nbsp;

<p class="MsoNormal">Prior to the commencement of the development hereby
approved, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing
by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how
the development will function in terms of the following: <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space:
a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an
evacuation assembly point<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which
reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire;
including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety
measures <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk
of fire spread<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and
associated evacuation strategy for all building users<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which
is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this
management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which
all building users can have confidence in <o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting
which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.<o:p></o:p></p><p>













</p><p class="MsoNormal">The development shall be operated in accordance with the
approved details in perpetuity.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p>No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Environmental</p><p>Management Plan (CEMP) has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.</p><p>The CEMP shall provide for:</p><p>(a) a preliminary ecological appraisal and preliminary roost assessment;</p><p>(b) a method statement detailing how any protected species will be protected during demolition and</p><p>construction;</p><p>(c) details of construction lighting;</p><p>(d) any permanent fixtures to be included as part of the final development to preserve or mitigate the</p><p>disruption of protected species habitats or passageways.</p><p>Should the preliminary ecological appraisal and preliminary roost assessment confirm the presence of bat</p><p>roosts a Protected Species Survey shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning</p><p>authority. Otherwise, the works shall be carried out in accordance with the approved CEMP, or any</p><p>amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority throughout the</p><p>construction period.</p><p>This is a PRE-COMMENCEMENT Condition.</p><p><br></p>

The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
